subject: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing

Hi Sarah / Tom 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned on scope for pricing:

1) Context & performance profile we discussed:
   - Typical interaction type: multi-turn assistant + retrieval augmentation.
   - Rough averages you mentioned on the call: ~600

~800 prompt tokens (user + system + retrieved context) and ~1,000

~1,500 completion tokens for the assistant reply.
   - Expected tail usage: ~15

~25% of requests will need >32k context (long documents), and ~5% will require 128k context for large-case summaries.

2) Monthly volumes (you estimated):
   - Active monthly users: ~40k
   - Avg requests/user/day (broadly): 3

~4
   - Estimated monthly tokens (combined prompt+completion): 200M

~400M (we can refine with a short sampling job).

3) Pricing / unit economics ask from you: target $/1M tokens and target monthly budget range.
   - You mentioned an internal target of ~$300

~$500 per 1M tokens for production SLAed endpoints.

Next steps (proposed):
- We'll run a 2-week sampling/profiling job to capture real prompt/completion distributions and the % of requests that hit 8k/32k/128k contexts. I'll send a small snippet (CSV) you can drop into your environment or we can instrument a short proxy to gather samples.
- Based on the samples, Jordan (our pricing lead) will produce a two-tier estimate: hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs. dedicated/reserved (committed capacity).
- If the sample aligns with your estimate, we'll produce target unit economics and a recommended configuration (batching, quantization profile) to hit your $/1M token target.

Attachments: I've attached the sampling template and our preliminary pricing estimate template.

Would you be ok with the 2-week sampling window starting this Friday (7/10)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

---
Attachment: acme_context_profile_sample.csv (CSV sampling template)
Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate_v2.pdf

From: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing

Thanks Marissa 

That looks good. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 15

~25% for >32k sounds right for search/knowledge-base style queries; the 5% for 128k is on the high side but possible for weekly executive summaries.
- For budgeting: our finance/ops team gave us a soft target of $400 / 1M tokens for the first year; if we can get down to ~$300 with a committed plan that would be ideal.

We're happy to start sampling on Friday. I can have engineering drop the sample CSV into our staging environment.

One ask: can Jordan include an estimate for token cost split (prompt vs completion) and the expected SLO impact if we switch some heavy users to a lower-latency dedicated pool?

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Li
Head of Product

Acme Corp

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing

Tom 

Great, thanks. Quick notes on what we'll deliver with the profiling output:

- Distribution: per-request histogram of prompt tokens and completion tokens (median, p75, p95, p99).
- Context-class breakdown: % requests that fit within 8k, 32k, 128k.
- Monthlyized token projection using your active user counts and request rates.
- Pricing scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) with unit $/1M tokens for each scenario and the expected monthly run rate.

Preliminary assumptions I'll use if sampling aligns with your earlier numbers:
- Avg prompt tokens: 650
- Avg completion tokens: 1,200
- Combined avg per request: ~1,850 tokens
- If monthly requests = 40k users * 3 req/day * 30 days = 3.6M requests -> ~6.7B tokens/month (this is illustrative; sampling will correct).

On unit economics: our ballpark (before committed discounts) for similar workloads is $150

~$450 / 1M tokens depending on model family and context length. With dedicated reserved capacity and quantization we typically can move towards the lower end for steady, high-volume workloads. I'll produce a concrete $/1M split for prompt vs completion and an expected blended $/1M in the follow-up estimate.

I'll kick off the profiling template and check-in after we have 48 hours of samples. Neha 

Please standby for any implementation questions from Acme eng.

Jordan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing

Tom / Marissa 

Quick implementation notes from engineering:

- The CSV template includes: request_id, timestamp, prompt_token_count, completion_token_count, model_hint, context_flag (8k/32k/128k), route_tag.
- Two simple ways to sample:
  1) Drop the CSV into staging and run a short proxy that writes token counts (recommended, minimal code).
  2) Add a small instrumentation call in your app that reports token counts to a secure S3 bucket we can access.

- For the sample job we only need ~48

~72 hours of traffic to get a stable p75/p95 for token sizes. If you want per-user tail analysis we can run 2 weeks.

I'll be on the thread during the sampling window 

Happy to help with the proxy.

Thanks,
Neha
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: 20260706-call-recording.mp3 (call recording)

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme.com>

Cc: Tom Li <tom.li@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Jul 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps: Acme context-length profiling + pricing

Thanks everyone 

We've scheduled the sampling proxy to go live Friday (7/10). A couple of quick confirmations:

- We'll start with 72 hours of data, then evaluate whether to extend to 2 weeks for tail usage.
- Finance has penciled a working budget range of $30k

~$60k / month for the first 6 months depending on unit economics; we'll update if sampling suggests higher/lower spend.

Jordan please include a short note in the estimate about how cross-request batching and KV caching could reduce effective prompt token compute for retrieval-heavy flows. That's a high priority for our SREs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround 

Looking forward to the profile.

Best,
Sarah
Director of Data Products | Acme Corp
